## PixelRank v1.0: Introducing Leaderboards to Your Minecraft Server!

Get ready to ignite competition and celebrate your players with the initial release of PixelRank! This lightweight Minecraft plugin lets you track and display leaderboards for various game statistics, boosting player engagement and adding a fun competitive element to your server.

**Key Features:**

* **Track Core Stats:** Showcase rankings for blocks mined, blocks placed, and total time played.
* **Optional Death Leaderboard:** Spice things up (or inspire a little more caution) with a leaderboard dedicated to tracking player deaths. (Disabled by default)
* **Easy Configuration:**  Fine-tune leaderboard settings and customize display options within the intuitive configuration file.
* **Lightweight Performance:** PixelRank is designed to operate with minimal impact on your server's performance, ensuring a smooth gameplay experience. 

**Ready to Rank Up Your Server?**

Download PixelRank v1.0.0 from the [Releases](https://github.com/CodeZhangBorui/PixelRank/releases) page and start showcasing your players' achievements! 

**We Value Your Feedback!**

This is just the beginning for PixelRank. Help us make it even better by reporting any issues or suggesting new features you'd like to see on our [Issues](https://github.com/CodeZhangBorui/PixelRank/issues) page.
